summary.zh: 一座悬浮于星海的微小庇护所。绕树而行，看光芒与萤火一起呼吸。
summary.en: A tiny sanctuary adrift among the stars. Orbit a luminous tree and watch its light breathe with the fireflies.

coverAlt.zh: 深蓝星空中的悬浮岩岛，岛上生长着一棵紫色发光树，萤火围绕树冠。
coverAlt.en: A floating rock island in a dark blue starfield, with a luminous violet tree and drifting fireflies.

text.zh: 拖动就能环绕整座岩岛，滚轮或双指靠近每一处细节。
text.en: Drag to circle the whole island. Scroll or pinch to move in on any detail.

text.zh: 树冠的光芒与萤火，以同一个节奏明灭。
text.en: The glow of the crown and the fireflies rise and fade to a single rhythm.

text.zh: 光芒滑块从 0% 到 100%，让这片庇护所更亮，或更静。
text.en: A glow slider from 0% to 100% makes the sanctuary brighter, or quieter.

text.zh: 程序化生成的云层，在岩岛下方缓缓流动。
text.en: Procedural clouds drift slowly beneath the rock.

text.zh: 打开声音，听见合成的星海氛围；暂停与复位随时可用。
text.en: Turn on a synthesized ambience of the star sea. Pause and reset are always at hand.
